encounters.notes: Proto-Dome Slag-Yards hub: the shave teacher; ASTRAL rings the bell. VHS Static Fog.
A Cassia-pattern spider with its gramophone cone and mercury pulse.
Spine-Highway: the Bike Bros guard the Ferro-Capacitor; Break-lock pins them for a Solar Railgun.
Mercury pools under a squire's shield wall; 12 fps frame-traps.
Choir of Arris Dome: Break-immune without a FERRO ally; harmonize them to sleep (Arris_Dome=Sleeping) or burn them (Arris_Dome=Incinerated).
Geno-Foundry conveyor: the press golem's heavy drift and magnetic crushers; syringes hammer every 3 s.
Mother Brain's Dyson-Cage: an elite rook pulls allies into Break-locked mites over boiling marrow tiles.
